column3: Lesson three. They can't see how hard it is to ask.
Nami's whole village knew what she was doing. Robin's crew had come all that way for her. But in the end, both of them had to say the words.
In another study, student advisors expected about thirteen classmates to come to them for help. Fewer than eight did.
People who offer help underestimate how awkward it feels to ask. So they wait. And you wait. And nothing happens.
The door is usually open. But someone has to knock.
